meta.title: RSVP Display
meta.description: Open and read .rsvp files in your browser.

errors.multipleFiles: Choose one .rsvp file at a time.
errors.openFile: Could not open this file. Please try again.
errors.binary: This file contains binary data. Choose a UTF-8 .rsvp file.
errors.version: The file must start with @rsvp 1. Only RSVP Nano version 1 is supported.
errors.header: Add a non-empty @title and @source on the second and third lines.
errors.metadata: @{{directive}} needs one non-empty value in the header.
errors.languageMissing: @language needs a BCP 47 language tag, such as en or ru.
errors.languageInvalid: Invalid @language tag. Use a BCP 47 tag, such as en or ru.
errors.direction: @direction must be auto, ltr, or rtl.
errors.directive: Unsupported directive @{{directive}}. To display a line starting with @, escape it as @@.
errors.noText: This file has no readable text. Add content after the header.
errors.extension: Choose a .rsvp file. Other document formats are not supported yet.
errors.tooLarge: This file is too large. Choose a file smaller than 10 MB.
errors.emptyFile: This file is empty. Choose a .rsvp file with some text.
errors.encoding: Could not read this file as UTF-8 text. Check its encoding and try again.
